mismatch.message: Replay error: W_SADDLE is not defined

summary: An opening wand ray that hits a pauper Knight's starting pony exposed an unbound W_SADDLE identifier in the JavaScript port of zap.c:bhitm. The C branch checks which_armor(mtmp, W_SADDLE) and does nothing when the pony has no saddle. The JS branch has the same absence check but js/zap.js omits W_SADDLE from its const.js imports, so replay stops before completing the branch.

source.branch: In bhitm's WAN_OPENING/SPE_KNOCK arm, after holder and trap handling, C checks which_armor(mtmp, W_SADDLE) and drops a found saddle. The case's pauper Knight pony has no saddle, so that lookup returns null and the branch makes no saddle change.

evidence: Read nethack-c/upstream/src/zap.c:160-573 and verified the WAN_OPENING branch at 382-434: after holder and trap handling, the branch looks up W_SADDLE and drops it only when which_armor returns an object. The C constant is declared in include/prop.h:125.

Read nethack-c/upstream/src/dog.c:219-275, especially makedog's pauper guard at 262: a pauper Knight's pony receives no starting saddle. The case therefore exercises the absence lookup, not saddle removal.

Read js/zap.js:3344-3702: bhitm mirrors the C branch and calls which_armor(monster, W_SADDLE, state), but W_SADDLE is missing from its const.js import list even though js/const.js exports it. The admitted C replay stops at this exact ReferenceError.

Focused scripts/zap-ray.test.mjs passed 70/70 including the complete v72 replay. ESLint passed. The admitted v72 synthetic range matched screens, cursors, and RNG through segment 0 step 173 (run-MJ6iXx).
